{{Top|leg}}
An '''armory ship''',<ref name="Alderaan">''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]''</ref> also known as an '''arsenal ship''',<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designation. Ships of this type were used to store [[Weapon|armaments]], rather than serving as full warships. The [[Alderaanian War Frigate]] ''[[Another Chance]]'' was an armory ship,<ref name="Alderaan" /> as was a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] vessel carrying [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and other armaments bound for a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] decommissioning station following the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].<ref name="RPG-Core" />
